pages.text: A Ritual Circle centre block, ringed by Ritual Glyph chalk marks, performs a rite. A small circle is twelve glyphs in a ring two blocks out, on the centre's level; each glyph needs solid ground beneath it.
Shift+Scroll while holding the chalk to cycle the selected rite; its tooltip shows the rite and the glyph count. Right-click the centre block to draw the whole ring at once.

To perform: complete the circle, drop the sacrifice item inside, and have a powered altar in range. Right-click the centre — the altar is debited first, then the sacrifice consumed, then the rite runs.
